segments.name: Athletic Country Club
segments.description: Operates resort-like athletic country clubs offering premium health, fitness and wellness experiences, services and programs to individual members and families.
segments.evidence: We design, build and operate our athletic country club destinations that are distinctive and large, multi-use sports and athletic, professional fitness, family recreation and spa centers in a resort-like environment.

revenueModel.text: Members pay monthly dues and enrollment fees for access to centers, plus in-center fees for personal training, kids programming, spas and cafés.
revenueModel.evidence: Center revenue consists of center membership and on-hold membership dues, enrollment fees and revenue generated within a center, which we refer to as in-center revenue.
